events.title: ZooLights at the Oregon Zoo
events.why: Nightly from 4:30 p.m. (closed Nov. 24 to 26 and Dec. 25) with dated tickets sold in advance; it fills the Washington Park lots and the Highway 26 exit on weekends.

events.title: OSAA football state championships
events.why: OSAA brackets set the 6A final for 1 p.m. and the 5A final for 5:30 p.m. Friday, Nov. 27 at Hillsboro Stadium, with the smaller classes crowned Saturday, so expect packed lots around the Hillsboro Hops' stadium over Thanksgiving weekend.

events.title: Pioneer Courthouse Square Tree Lighting
events.why: The 42nd annual lighting of the 75-foot tree, 5:30 to 6:45 p.m. the day after Thanksgiving, packs downtown and slows buses and MAX around the square.

events.title: Ramon Ayala Historia De Un Final
events.why: Coliseum concert by the norteño star the day after Thanksgiving, the same evening as the Pioneer Courthouse Square tree lighting.

events.title: Winter Wonderland holiday lights
events.why: Sunshine Division's drive-through light show runs nightly on the raceway track (5 to 10 p.m. weekdays, 4:30 to 11 p.m. weekends and Dec. 16 to 25), backing up traffic on North Victory Boulevard and near the I-5 Delta Park exit.

events.title: Trans-Siberian Orchestra: The Ghosts of Christmas Eve
events.why: Two shows (3:30 and 8 p.m.) on the 30th anniversary tour the Saturday after Thanksgiving, so the Rose Quarter is busy most of the day.

events.title: Timbers vs. FC Dallas, MLS Cup Playoffs Round One Game 2
events.why: Must-win home match, 7:30 p.m. Saturday on FS1, after FC Dallas won Game 1 3-0 in Frisco on Nov. 21; a Portland win forces Game 3 in Texas, so expect a sellout plus Goose Hollow traffic and MAX crowds.

events.title: USA Track and Field Annual Meeting
events.why: Week-long USATF annual meeting in the convention center's Oregon Ballroom, bringing national track and field delegates to the Lloyd District.

events.title: Christmas Ships Parade
events.why: Lit boat fleets sail different stretches of both rivers on most evenings, drawing crowds to riverfront parks and restaurants; the route changes nightly, so check the schedule.

events.title: Triumph with April Wine: The Rock & Roll Machine Reloaded Tour
events.why: Saturday 8 p.m. arena show on the Canadian rockers' 50th anniversary tour, so expect evening Rose Quarter traffic and busy MAX trains.

events.title: The American Northwest Portland Nationals (cheer and dance)
events.why: Varsity's weekend cheer and dance championship fills Hall D with teams and families, so Lloyd District parking and MAX trains will be busy.

events.title: The Wolf's Nice Christmas Show
events.why: Sunday 7 p.m. country radio holiday show with Max McNown, Ian Munsick, Graham Barham and Blake Whiten, the night after the Triumph show next door, so the Rose Quarter is busy two nights running.

events.title: Crafty Wonderland Holiday Art + Craft Market 2026
events.why: Hundreds of local artists sell handmade goods in Hall D, with a ticketed preview night Friday 5 to 9 p.m. and timed-entry tickets Saturday and Sunday 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., so Lloyd District parking and MAX will be busy.

events.title: Build, Remodel & Landscape Show 2027
events.why: Weekend home and garden show for the public in Hall A, the same weekend as the Aloha Portland Showdown cheer event in Halls B and C, so Lloyd District parking will be tight.

events.title: Portland Boat Show
events.why: The 67th annual show fills the Expo Center for five days in mid-January, so expect busy I-5 exits and MAX Yellow Line trains near Delta Park.

events.title: Ram PBR Portland
events.why: Two nights of PBR bull riding (Friday 8 p.m., Saturday 7 p.m.) on its 2027 tour, so expect Rose Quarter traffic and busy MAX trains both evenings.

events.title: The Portland Wedding Show
events.why: Ticketed weekend bridal show in Hall D, overlapping the PDX Invitational gymnastics meet in Hall C, so the convention center will be busy all weekend.
